 Updated: 8:36 AM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Lauren Hope Meteorologist FORT MYERS, Fla. — Wednesday is a Gulf Coast Weather Impact Day as widespread rain impacts the morning commute. Give yourself plenty of extra time and avoid ponding on the roads. 
 Your Gulf Coast Weather Most Accurate Forecast calls for the coverage to slowly decrease by the evening. The main threats are heavy rain, minor flooding and occasional lightning. 
 Advertisement Gulf Coast News Weather Impacts Despite the widespread rain and mostly cloudy skies, highs will still reach the upper 70s. 
 As an area of low pressure develops off the southeastern U.S. toward the end of the work week, moisture will lift north and the Gulf Coast will finally dry out. Isolated rain is still expected Thursday and Friday, though drier weather returns for the weekend. 
 In the tropics, hurricane season comes to an end in under two weeks. No development is expected over the next seven days.
